question.worked_solution:
We need to calculate the product of $7.3$ with itself:

$$
{7.3}^{2}=(7.3)\cdot (7.3)
$$

First, we ignore the decimal points and multiply as if both numbers were whole numbers:

$$
\begin{aligned} & \begin{aligned} &  &  & \,\,\,\,\begin{aligned}\boxed{2} \\ \boxed{}\end{aligned}\,\,\,\, &  \\  &  &  & \,\,\,\,7\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,3\,\,\,\, \\ \,\,\,\,\times \,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,7\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,3\,\,\,\, \\  &  & \,\,\,\,2\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,1\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,9\,\,\,\, \\ \,\,\,\,+\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,5\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,1\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,1\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,0\,\,\,\, \\  & \,\,\,\,5\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,3\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,2\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,9\,\,\,\,\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $73\times 73=5\,329.$

We now count the total number of decimal places in the two factors.

There is $1$ decimal place in the first factor ($7.3$) and $1$ decimal place in the second factor ($7.3$), so their product will have $1+1=2$ decimal places.

We take our value of $5\,329$ and insert a decimal point to make a number with $2$ decimal places:

$$
53\,\overset{↓}{.}\,\,\,{{29}_{⏟}}_{2\text{ digits}}
$$

Therefore, ${7.3}^{2}=53.29\,.$
